design_axis: APP VISUAL real current-question to causal-history task flow
bounded_question: Can one current unresolved question deepen into adjacent historical cause and deeper history inside the COMP shell while preserving temporal status, bounded disclosure, exact origin and exact return without creating a permanent Archive/History mode or rollback semantics?

close_reconciliation.effect: No contradiction. Website main advanced only for non-production Bellweather PERSON-state work and explicitly freezes app UI; Engineering supplies no new causal/history Product semantics.

controlled_inputs: Light F2 / Dark D3 / MAT F1 / TYP F1 / STA F2 / FICON F1
accepted source-derived Scene-12 ledger question + Scene-10 historical witness

local_result.summary: The current Scene-12 ledger question now opens one adjacent Scene-10 historical cause and then exclusive deeper causal-history depth. Historical focus never moves current selection, every prior witness stays dashed/labeled Historical, and Back/Close return to the same current question and trigger focus.

visual: wide current Light/Dark pair with selected current question and independently focused dashed historical witness
wide deep Light/Dark pair with solid Current card beside dashed Historical cards
historical status remains textual/structural rather than color/darkness-dependent
interaction: causal-history affordance disappears when unrelated meaning is selected and restores for the current ledger question
history witness focus is independent from current-question selection
deep history opens in both themes while Shaping is hidden
Back and Close each restore causal-history trigger focus and current-question selection

constrains: Future causal/history carriers preserve current semantic origin, explicit historical status at every depth, bounded disclosure/provenance, contextual availability and exact return unless a named successor supersedes them.

explicit_non_authority: No consequence review, replay, rollback, branching or mutation mechanics.
No exhaustive causal graph, causal score, inference engine or generated-explanation authority.
No motion/Stage successor, production tokens, native implementation, shipping or Store authority.

director_review_surface.what_to_review: current-question primacy, historical structural status, causal adjacency, exclusive deep history, bounded disclosure and exact return
